title: Trainingpeaks Metric1 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:metric1 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in trainingpeaks metric1 (1) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme trainingpeaks metric1 (1) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It scans the unusually high or low value moments in your trainingpeaks metric1 (1) history.
